answer_sentences.text: Clause 7.4 does impose foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding for all term loans pre-closed by the borrower, but the provided sources do not include the RBI’s current foreclosure-charge rule, so compliance cannot be confirmed from these materials alone.
answer_sentences.quote: 7.4 Foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower.
